clue.text: Nanny's tender love, coming in to collect daughter

indicators.note: love enters the word for collect, sitting inside it

parts.note: to gather is to collect
love is nil in tennis, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A caring nanny takes in a daughter out of love.
explanation.walkthrough: Nanny is not a childminder but a female goat, and the tender is the person who tends her.
explanation.definitionFit: A goatherd is someone who looks after goats, so a nanny goat's keeper fits.

clue.text: Building in garden where a serving of wine is free?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a greenhouse made of glass

definitions.text: where a serving of wine is free?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, whimsically: a house where the glass is on the house

explanation.walkthrough: On the house means free; a pub where your glass is on the house would be a glass house.
explanation.definitionFit: A glasshouse is a greenhouse, a glazed structure for growing plants.

clue.text: Killer insect wife brushed off

parts.note: a wasp is a stinging insect

explanation.definitionFit: The asp is a venomous snake, famous as the one that killed Cleopatra.

clue.text: Gathering there's no end of damage on tunic

clue.text: Picked up suitable one to wear fancy raincoat for approval

clue.text: River runs away from country houses

parts.note: a grange is a country house with farm buildings

explanation.surface: A river flows off from a country estate.

clue.text: Inflexible barrier installed by a worker

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Wonderful group of friends that takes the longest route round the world

definitions.text: that takes the longest route round the world
definitions.note: a noun phrase for a circle that runs the full span of the globe

explanation.walkthrough: A great circle is the largest possible circle on a sphere, though following one gives the shortest flight between two points.
explanation.definitionFit: A great circle divides a sphere into two equal halves, like the equator on Earth.

clue.text: River gets clogged up in sound

clue.text: Unsteady, twisted across wide street

clue.text: One very meticulous stage work

explanation.walkthrough: Split as the care taker, it describes a meticulous person; whole, it is Pinter's play.
explanation.definitionFit: The Caretaker is a celebrated play by Harold Pinter, and the phrase also describes someone who takes great care.

clue.text: Most modern part of the US, regularly a vital part

oft is an old word for often, regularly
the heart is a vital organ

clue.text: In refurbished inn, a relaxed six-footer

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Spare time not disguised

parts.note: spare food is left over

clue.text: Army head acquires a second scar

taken as written
a trice is an instant, a second

ugh is what you say at something disgusting

clue.text: Spots parent with a clue for resolving

clue.text: Vanity cases?
